rules.colloquial_term: items whose id holds -colloquial-term- (both splits, report-only per EVAL-14): no Recall@5, Recall@10 or MRR paired mean falls and at least one rises
rules.other_slices: gated items without the term items: every overall, language and category slice stays within noise.floor (one run per side, so k x spread is 0) for every noise.metrics metric
rules.no_answer_term_refusal: items whose id holds -no_answer-term-: every item refused on exactly when refused off
rules.latency: on-run p95 of terminology and search within the chat stage budgets; the pre-generation chat total within total_p50_ms and total_p95_ms
rules.retrieval_config_hash: the off and on runs share no retrieval_config_hash
